hazards.description: Parked cars and a large bus block sightlines between pedestrians attempting to cross and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or buffer zone between the wide sidewalk and the active vehicle travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on unpaved ground or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas across a wide, multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles are visible along this stretch, which would make the wide sidewalk feel unsafe or hazardous at night.

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a crash risk for cyclists.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Parking Lot Entrance
hazards.description: A wide, undefined entrance to a parking lot creates a large conflict zone where vehicles may turn across the pedestrian path without clear markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, where the sidewalk meets the parking lot entrance.

hazards.name: Unmarked wide crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks marked crosswalks, requiring pedestrians to judge gaps in traffic across multiple lanes and tracks without protection.

hazards.name: Utility Pole in Walkway
hazards.description: A utility pole is situated on the sidewalk, which, while not fully blocking the path, creates a fixed-object hazard and slightly narrows the clear walking width.

hazards.name: Embedded rail tracks
hazards.description: The tracks in the center of the roadway create a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for cyclists.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the right side of the street may block the view of pedestrians attempting to cross from that side.

hazards.name: Wide, undefined parking lot access
hazards.description: The entire frontage of the parking lot lacks a defined curb, allowing vehicles to cross the sidewalk at any point, creating unpredictable conflict zones.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the middle ground where the parking lot meets the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation or planting strip to protect pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edge of the foreground sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the street and in the lot block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Parked cars in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is situated within the sidewalk area, which, while not blocking the path entirely, creates a minor pinch point.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Driveway Access
hazards.description: The wide, undefined entrance to the parking lot creates a large conflict zone where vehicles cross the pedestrian path at various angles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, foreground to mid-ground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and pedestrian-warning signage to provide a designated safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Supplement existing street lighting with lower-height fixtures focused on the walkway to improve nighttime safety.

interventions.title: Street Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at intersections to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing zebra markings to high-visibility longitudinal patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a psychological buffer between the sidewalk and traffic and to encourage slower driving speeds through vertical enclosure.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the wide sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe access to the senior center.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk on the left side to accommodate higher pedestrian volumes and mobility aids.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in a furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb would provide shade and a better physical buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at the nearest intersection.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Incentives
interventions.description: Encourage the use of transparent windows and active ground-floor uses instead of solid shutters to improve the pedestrian experience and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked midblock crossing with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the road to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Planters
interventions.description: Adding a furniture zone with planters or trees would create a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the left side of the street.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island in the center.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge islands
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to ensure a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees and a planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a more robust physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crossings with signage to provide safe points for pedestrians to traverse the street.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Install curbing to define specific, narrow entry and exit points for the parking lot, reducing the area where vehicles cross the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the walking path to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians.
